description.zh:
您要查询的域名。域名可以是以下类型：

- 推流域名。

- 主播流域名。

- 子播流域名。
description.en:
The domain that you want to query. Valid types:

- Ingest domain

- Main streaming domain

- Sub-streaming domain

descriptions.zh:
先获取需要查询的推流域名、主播流域名和子播流域名，再调用本接口查询直播域名映射。

## QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为500次/分钟。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
Before you call this operation, identify the ingest or streaming domain that you want to query.

## QPS limits

You can call this operation up to 500 times per minute per account. Requests that exceed this limit are dropped and you may experience service interruptions.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun live describe-live-domain-mapping --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --domain-name example.com --region cn-hangzhou
